subject: Security checklist & next-step commitments — Secured Inc discovery
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@securedinc.com>, Secured Inc Security <security@securedinc.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@securedinc.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 4, 2027 at 1:02 PM -0700
Subject: Security checklist & next-step commitments — Secured Inc discovery

Hi Oliver / Secured team,

Thanks again for the 45-min discovery this morning. Quick written summary so we have a single place to track asks and owners. High-level pain & goals you shared: 

- Compliance must-haves: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), pen test summary, and an artifact list for audit.
- Audit log requirements: immutable, exportable logs with at least 7 years retention; access controls for auditors.
- DPA / data residency: DPA needs redline for standard EU clause (you mentioned a subgroup with APAC later); customer data must be segregated per tenant.
- Evidence intake: you prefer SFTP/secure Drive intake + an intake spreadsheet and one consolidated artifact map.
- Timeline: pilot in Q3; SOC 2 evidence requested for procurement review by 2027-06-15.

What we (Redwood) will provide: attached artifact map (redwood_soc2_artifact_map.pdf) with initial pointers, a proposed intake checklist (securedinc_input_checklist.xlsx) you can use to upload artifacts, and a DPA draft (signed_dpa_draft.docx) for your legal review.

Next steps / owners (quick):
- Secured Inc: confirm which SOC 2 period you need (most recent 12-month window) and provide the procurement contact for legal redlines. (Oliver)
- Secured Inc: upload any existing pen test report + high-level remediation plan to the Drive folder by 2027-05-12. (Security team)
- Redwood: Ben will map the artifact locations to our audit playbook and note any gaps by 2027-05-07. (Ben)
- Redwood: I'll share a proposed evidence-intake workflow and a short SLA for log exports (within 3 business days) by 2027-05-06. (Tessa)

Attachments: redwood_soc2_artifact_map.pdf, securedinc_input_checklist.xlsx, signed_dpa_draft.docx

If that matches your understanding, can you confirm and I'll kick off the Drive folder and HubSpot deal updates? Happy to sync again if you want to walk through the artifact map.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@securedinc.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Secured Inc Security <security@securedinc.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@securedinc.com>
Date: Tue, May 4, 2027 at 3:45 PM -0700
Subject: Re: Security checklist & next-step commitments — Secured Inc discovery

Tessa — thanks for the clear write-up. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- SOC 2: procurement wants the latest Type II for the 12-month period ending 2027-03-31; we can supply that.
- Pen test: we have a high-level pen test report (Q4 2026) and a remediation summary — we'll upload both.
- Logs: 7 years retention is a must for regulators, but our internal security team will also need a tamper-evident export mechanism (hashing + signed manifests). Is that part of Redwood's log export?
- DPA: legal will review your draft and push redlines to you via DocuSign by next week.

We'll start populating the Drive folder today with the procurement contact info and the initial pen test documents. Can Ben confirm whether Redwood can sign a standard SOC 2-friendly addendum around log hashing and certificate retention?

Oliver
Head of Procurement
Secured Inc

Attachments: SecuredInc_Q42026_Pentest_Summary.pdf (uploaded to shared Drive)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, May 5, 2027 at 10:12 AM -0700
Subject: Fwd: Security checklist & next-step commitments — Secured Inc discovery

Forwarding Oliver's reply and the initial artifacts they've uploaded. Quick internal notes / recommended commitments for proposals: 

> On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 3:45 PM Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@securedinc.com> wrote:
> [quoted message omitted]

My assessment:
- SOC 2 artifacts: we can map ~85% of requested artifacts to our existing evidence bundles. The remaining items are around retention proof and long-term log immutability (they want hashing + signed manifests).
- Logs: we currently support signed log export via S3 + manifest (SHA256). We can offer a configurable retention policy and export cadence. Implementation effort: minimal config + a short runbook for auditors.
- DPA redlines: most common ask is the data residency + subprocessor disclosure. Legal usually accepts our standard subprocessor schedule; I'll draft a short DPA addendum that clarifies log handling (hashing, manifests) and retention SLAs.
- Pen test: if they require a copy of our internal pen test results, we typically provide an executive summary and attestation letter; full reports are redacted.

Proposed responses to give Secured Inc (to close procurement loop):
1) Provide SOC 2 Type II summary + artifact map (done)
2) Confirm log export mechanism with sample manifest (provide sample by 2027-05-07) — Owner: Ben
3) Draft DPA addendum that calls out log immutability and retention (draft by 2027-05-06) — Owner: Marcus
4) Offer a short technical call with Security Engineer to walk auditors (schedule week of 2027-05-10)

I'll attach a sample manifest and short README in the Drive folder today. Marcus — can you take the DPA addendum draft? I can handle the manifest + sample export config.

—Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: sample_log_manifest.json (internal), audit_readme.md (internal)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@securedinc.com>, Secured Inc Security <security@securedinc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, May 6, 2027 at 9:18 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Security checklist & next-step commitments — Secured Inc discovery

Oliver / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for uploading the pen test summary. Confirming the plan below so procurement has clear milestones: 

Committed deliverables & dates:
- Redwood: sample signed log manifest + README uploaded to Drive by 2027-05-07 (Ben) — DONE (see folder).
- Redwood: DPA addendum draft (log handling + retention) sent to your legal via DocuSign by 2027-05-06 (Marcus). We'll accept most standard redlines but will flag anything that materially impacts multi-tenant isolation.
- Secured Inc: procurement to confirm SOC 2 period (12 months ending 2027-03-31) and confirm the auditor contact by 2027-05-12 (Oliver).
- Joint: schedule 30-min technical walk-through for auditors the week of 2027-05-10 — propose Tue 2027-05-11 at 10am PT. Please confirm availability.

I've updated HubSpot (Deal DEAL-4812) with these milestones and placed the Drive links under the deal record: https://hubspot.com/deal/4812. If you approve, I'll create the calendar invite for Tue 2027-05-11 10am PT and attach the manifest sample + artifact map.

Appreciate the clarity — we want procurement to have everything they need to move this to legal review.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
